doctrine.signalRule: A source monitor signal creates an internal review candidate only. It never creates a public Civic Timeline item.
doctrine.promotionRule: Promotion requires item-level evidence, an explicit public temporal semantic/date, and a canonical owner/reference.
doctrine.reachabilityRule: Reachability-only sources are discovery surfaces. A successful reachability check does not prove that no new civic date exists.
doctrine.ownerRule: If a stronger canonical owner exists, promote to that owner and keep the discovery source as provenance rather than create a City Monitor duplicate.

sources.label: Makati Events
sources.note: Promote civic/service/public-information occurrences only. Generic entertainment remains outside the Civic Timeline.

sources.label: Makati News
sources.note: News items need item-level dates and canonical routing before promotion.

sources.label: MyMakati official social broadcasts
sources.note: Social-platform broadcasts are discovery/evidence only until the exact official item and date are preserved.

sources.label: PhilGEPS
sources.note: A portal hash change is not an exact Makati procurement match. Promotion requires an item-specific Makati record.

sources.label: Resilient Makati consultations and public participation
sources.note: A specific consultation/hearing item needs an explicit date/window before promotion.

sources.label: MACEA circulars and advisories
sources.note: Estate circulars may support scoped Makati CBD mobility/service impacts when exact dates and affected roads/areas are stated.

sources.label: COMELEC 2026 BSKE election calendar
sources.note: The base calendar must be reviewed together with later COMELEC amendments before any current milestone is promoted.

sources.label: COMELEC 2026 BSKE voter registration rules
sources.note: Registration dates are official-source candidates; promotion still requires a canonical Elections milestone record.

sources.label: COMELEC announcements
sources.note: Use to discover later amendments/notices. Reachability alone does not identify a milestone.

sources.label: PSA population table
sources.note: Observation/as-of periods never become release dates. Capture the official release/publication timestamp separately.

sources.label: PSA provincial product accounts
sources.note: Only official release/publication dates can feed Recently Published.

sources.label: Commission on Audit annual reports
sources.note: A newly catalogued audit needs item identity and publication/release evidence before promotion.

sources.label: Makati official publications
sources.note: Publication identity and release date are required; portal reachability is not enough.

sources.label: Makati Action Center Citizen's Charter
sources.note: A charter document change requires review; only explicit effective dates/deadlines become timeline candidates.
